title: Q-REDTEAM-home-placeholder: the homepage says '371 of 371 claims verified at commit generated' with a placeholder where the commit hash belongs
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** red-team pass (REDTEAM-1), daily
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation redteam --probe
**Status:** open

Found by reading production as a stranger on 2026-11-25. Root cause: site homepage generator for the claims line. Fix the producer, not the page text. Closing probe: GET https://ultrastable.io/ shows a real commit hash and no 'at commit generated'.
